set.body:
The end-to-end acceptance for MVP 1.0 (owner goal 2026-09-22): map Sherlock recall to the video using annotations only, and using annotations plus video-derived evidence, through the public prepare -> facade -> exchange -> fMRI path, and run the same journey on a text story + recall pair. Split from the (now 1.1) organization preview bd-01M2WVJ8HKX6EHG2C5CXYEZYJ6.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Inputs enter only through the public prepare path bd-01M35B05TC6GBED9Z3HZMX618E from ordinary files (Sherlock annotation table + recall word CSVs; the video-only source package bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF for the A+V arm; the WOG text + a recall for the text arm). No embed-bench import, no STORYMODEL4S_* environment configuration.
2. Two Sherlock arms on development participants only: A (annotations) and A+V (annotations + captions/shot evidence produced by bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF, receipt-checked). Same unit inventory, cut and denominators for both arms; per-arm outputs retained even if A+V does not improve.
3. Every run publishes both mappings (local reference and structured reconstruction, facade bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM) and at least lambda in (0, 0.5, 1) via bd-01M35MHPFFKQHSJKC07VMWC7CW; outputs are G1 checked records plus exchange tables bd-01M2WVHF4B5DAXJYY4W91VK4WV, read back by the independent Python/R reader.
4. Parity: the structured-reconstruction A arm reproduces the bench historical preset (sherlockRecallMap) scores from bd-01M35JFJCQ2ANTVED792H705X6 on the same participants, or every difference is explained and receipted.
5. Temporal queries bd-01M3549Q5W5KQFSY3ZH81FARM0 and the OpenNeuro ds001132 export bd-01M354E83Z4Z7DR4KPP6Q45MAJ run on one development participant from these outputs.
6. No organization/order readout is offered (1.1, container bd-01M35P2EKWC52PZTMN2R5NMDFR); a request for one fails with an explicit missing-capability outcome.
7. Documented as a reader walkthrough (docs bead bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R).

Out of scope: sealed test splits, calibrated probabilities, accuracy claims beyond the development readout.
Evidence: exact SHA, commands, bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, separate SD6 cold review.
set.title: [G2] 1.0 mapping journey: Sherlock annotations-only and annotations+video, plus a text story, through the public path
